title: Merz Attacks Far Right for Russia Stance, ‘Ethnic Cleansing’
title_cn: 梅尔茨攻击极右翼俄罗斯立场“种族清洗”
summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz lashed out at the far-right Alternative for Germany for its embrace of Russia and migration aims that he said amount to “ethnic cleansing” as the government grapples with the fallout from the party’s election win this week.

title: UK, France and Canada Hit Israeli Settlements With Sanctions
title_cn: 英国、法国和加拿大对以色列定居点实施制裁
summary: The UK, France, Canada and other countries announced coordinated measures against Israeli settlements in the West Bank, as western nations sought to raise pressure on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government.

title: Najib Said to Seek 1MDB Pardon as Anwar’s Coalition Resists
title_cn: 纳吉布称寻求 1MDB 赦免，但安瓦尔联盟抵制
summary: Malaysia’s jailed former premier Najib Razak is seeking another royal intervention in his corruption conviction linked to the multibillion dollar 1MDB scandal, according to people familiar with the matter, a move that’s drawn opposition from Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s coalition.

title: Iran Accuses the US of Using Nuclear Watchdog to Justify Strikes
title_cn: 伊朗指责美国利用核监管机构为袭击辩护
summary: Iran accused the US and Israel of cloaking military strikes against its nuclear facilities beneath the legal authority wielded by inspectors at the United Nations nuclear watchdog.
